subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 as its first passive-capture contract, and which provenance and completeness fields must persist through backup and restore?
rationale: The feature fits Birdclaw’s vision, but external schema support and persistent attribution form a long-lived product and data-model contract that cannot be selected safely from source evidence alone.

options.title: Scrollmark v1 first
options.body: Support only validated Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially, with durable import provenance and explicit partial-collection semantics.

options.title: Multi-format first release
options.body: Support canonical and legacy Scrollmark plus twitter-web-exporter immediately, accepting a larger detection and compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer external captures
options.body: Keep official archives and live transports as the only supported ingestion sources until external formats mature further.

recommendation.title: Scrollmark v1 first
recommendation.body: Support only validated Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially, with durable import provenance and explicit partial-collection semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the published product vision and recent canonical persistence direction affected by this decision.
